description: 4-channel analog output module (4-20 mA, 0-20 mA, 0-5 V or 0-10 V) controlled over RS485 with Modbus RTU
source: ATO, RS485 to 4-20mA/0-5V/0-10V Converter, 4 Channel, User Manual: holding register address definition

sources.title: RS485 to 4-20mA/0-5V/0-10V Converter, 4 Channel, User Manual
sources.note: holding register table, output scaling and examples

notes: Addresses are the hex addresses of the manual's register table (07D0H = 2000). Functions 03 and 04 read the registers and 06 writes them.
Factory default: address 1, 4800 bit/s, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
The manual's table lists channel 4 as '0001 H' with PLC address 40004; the PLC address and the sequence give 0003H, used here.

registers.name: Channel 1 output value
registers.description: 0 to 4095 (12-bit) over the output range: 4-20 mA = value / 4095 x 16 + 4 mA; 0-20 mA = value / 4095 x 20 mA; 0-5 V = value / 4095 x 5 V; 0-10 V = value / 4095 x 10 V.
